svg.title: Chunk boundaries can separate required facts
svg.desc: An illustrative small-window split separates the INR 12000 annual amount from the qualification that it is one combined limit. A wider or overlapping window can preserve both facts. Actual splitter offsets and overlap must be inspected, not inferred from the picture.

g.text: Retrieve the qualification as well as the amount.
Illustration only: these boxes are not measured splitter offsets.
Up to INR 12000 per calendar year for eligible items...
...one combined annual limit, not a limit per item.
Qualification may be missed when only A is retrieved
INR 12000 + calendar year + combined limit can appear together; inspect actual output.
Trade-off: more context may preserve support while increasing duplicated or irrelevant text.
